description: Fix admin settings UI: (1) make the homepage settings form functional by extracting a client component; (2) add error handling in settings-actions.ts so missing site_settings table doesn't crash the UI; (3) add all 6 missing settings sub-pages; (4) add the site_settings migration doc. Depends on nothing in FEAT-001 or FEAT-003. All work is in app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/ and lib/supabase/settings-actions.ts.
steps: FIX 9 + FIX 5 (error handling first, since pages depend on it) — In lib/supabase/settings-actions.ts, wrap the getSiteSettings() query in a try/catch that catches the PGRST116 error code (table not found) and returns { success: true, data: [] } instead of throwing. The current code already wraps in try/catch and returns { success: false, error: error.message } — change it so that if error.code === 'PGRST116' or error.message includes 'does not exist', return { success: true, data: [] }. Same pattern for getSiteSetting() — return { success: true, data: null } on PGRST116. This prevents admin crashes when site_settings table is not yet deployed.

FIX 5 (migration doc) — Create supabase/migrations/apply_site_settings_schema.md with instructions: 'Copy and paste the contents of supabase/schema/SITE_SETTINGS_SCHEMA.sql into the Supabase SQL Editor and run it. Note: The RLS policy in SITE_SETTINGS_SCHEMA.sql references admin_users table but the actual table is admin_profiles — replace admin_users with admin_profiles and user_id with id in the policy before running.'

FIX 3 — Create app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/homepage/homepage-settings-form.tsx as a 'use client' component. Pattern: copy the structure from app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/site/site-settings-form.tsx. Props interface: { initialSettings: Record<string, any> }. The handleSubmit handler calls updateMultipleSettings() from lib/supabase/settings-actions with category: 'homepage' for all fields. The fields and their setting keys come from SITE_SETTINGS_SCHEMA.sql homepage rows: hero_title, hero_subtitle, hero_cta_primary, hero_cta_secondary, featured_projects_title, featured_projects_description, about_title, about_description, cta_title, cta_description, cta_button. Each form input gets name=<key> so FormData can collect them all. Use toast.success/toast.error from sonner for feedback. Include a loading state with Loader2 spinner on Save button.

FIX 3 (cont.) — Rewrite app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/homepage/page.tsx as a server component (keep it as-is structure-wise) that: (a) fetches site_settings with category='homepage' using the server supabase client, (b) converts the array to a settingsMap keyed by setting.key with JSON.parse on each value (same pattern as app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/site/page.tsx lines 28-35), (c) renders the page header (keep existing ArrowLeft, Layout icon, Preview Live button), (d) renders <HomepageSettingsForm initialSettings={settingsMap} /> in place of the raw form sections. Remove the broken multiple separate <form> tags. Keep the requireAdmin() + role check at top.

FIX 7 — Create three functional settings sub-pages that use site_settings:
  - app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/email/page.tsx: server component fetching category='email' from site_settings, extracting settingsMap, then rendering an EmailSettingsForm client component. EmailSettingsForm fields: smtp_host, smtp_port, smtp_user, smtp_from_name, smtp_from_email. Calls updateMultipleSettings with category='email'.
  - app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/email/email-settings-form.tsx: client form component, same pattern as site-settings-form.tsx.
  - app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/theme/page.tsx: server component fetching category='theme', rendering ThemeSettingsForm.
  - app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/theme/theme-settings-form.tsx: client form with fields primary_color (color input), secondary_color (color input), accent_color (color input), font_heading (text), font_body (text), dark_mode_enabled (checkbox). Calls updateMultipleSettings with category='theme'.
  - app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/security/page.tsx: server component fetching category='security', rendering SecuritySettingsForm.
  - app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/security/security-settings-form.tsx: client form with fields captcha_enabled (checkbox), rate_limit_enabled (checkbox), max_requests_per_minute (number input), session_timeout (number input), password_min_length (number input). Calls updateMultipleSettings with category='security'.

FIX 7 (cont.) — Create three informational sub-pages (no DB interaction):
  - app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/media/page.tsx: server component with requireAdmin(). Shows a card explaining that media files are managed via Supabase Storage. Links to /admin/projects, /admin/team, /admin/services for image management. No form, just informational UI matching the rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-6 style.
  - app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/database/page.tsx: server component with requireAdmin(). Shows database info: lists the known tables (contacts, client_inquiries, projects, team_members, services, testimonials, job_postings, newsletter_subscribers, consultation_requests, partnerships, complaints, admin_profiles, crm_leads, crm_deals, crm_activities, crm_tasks, site_settings). Instructions for accessing Supabase dashboard. No form.
  - app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/advanced/page.tsx: server component with requireAdmin(). Shows presence/absence of each env var without revealing values: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL (✅/❌), NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (✅/❌), SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (✅/❌), GMAIL_USER (✅/❌), GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD (✅/❌), ADMIN_EMAIL (✅/❌), NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY (✅/❌), RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY (✅/❌). Use process.env[key] ? '✅ Set' : '❌ Not set'. Never display actual values.
acceptance_criteria: Visiting /admin/settings/homepage renders the form populated with DB values (or hard-coded defaults when site_settings table is missing), and Save button submits and shows toast success/error
getSiteSettings() in settings-actions.ts returns { success: true, data: [] } instead of crashing when site_settings table does not exist

All 6 previously-404 settings sub-pages render without error: /admin/settings/email, /admin/settings/theme, /admin/settings/security, /admin/settings/media, /admin/settings/database, /admin/settings/advanced
Email, Theme, and Security settings forms save to site_settings table successfully (when table exists)
pnpm run type-check passes with no new errors
verification: pnpm run type-check — zero TypeScript errors
pnpm run build — builds successfully, all 8 settings routes compile
